name: ExcelInstanceId
label: ExcelInstanceId
description: The Excel instance ID or token.

name: Activate
label: Activate
description: Select whether to specify the cell to activate absolutely or relatively.

name: Column
label: Column
description: The numeric value or letter of the cell column.

name: Row
label: Row
description: The numeric value of the cell row. The numbering starts from 1.

name: Direction
label: Direction
description: Select where to look for the cell to activate based on the position of the currently active cell.

name: OffsetFromActiveCell
label: OffsetFromActiveCell
description: Offset distance between the currently active cell and the desired cell. The numbering starts from 0.
